title: Baroreceptor Reflex Blood Pressure Regulation
author: OpenStax College
caption: OpenStax diagram of the arterial baroreceptor reflex responding to decreased or increased blood pressure to restore cardiovascular homeostasis.
alt_text: Flowchart diagram showing baroreceptor sensing of blood pressure changes and autonomic heart rate and vasoconstriction responses.
clinical_relevance: Explains the baroreceptor reflex mechanism that is deconditioned during microgravity, predisposing crew to orthostatic intolerance upon gravity well entry (CLIFF-014, p.1).
